mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROOM (ROOM_ID, ROOM_UUID, MAX_PARTICIPANTS, STAGE, CREATED_AT, EXPIRES_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{roomUuid}, #{maxParticipants}, #{stage}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM SET TRAVEL_MODE = #{mode}, STAGE = #{stage} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
UPDATE ROOM SET STAGE = #{stage} WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID FROM ROOM WHERE EXPIRES_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRES_AT < #{now}
